new_categories.label: cargo_mass_monitoring_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-mass temperature/self-heating monitoring is a delivered observation service-state distinct from general hold-environment monitoring.

new_categories.label: cargo_scope_coverage_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring coverage can be bounded to a cargo parcel, hold or zone without retaining exact sensor or sampling locations.

new_categories.label: sensor_measurement_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of the measurement path can be represented separately from the validity of the resulting indication without retaining instrument type or method.

new_categories.label: measurement_path_integrity_confidence
new_categories.memory: A bounded confidence in the measurement path or interface is distinct from actual cargo temperature and from the interpretation of a trend.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that the indication meaningfully represents the bounded cargo scope can be retained without exact temperature values or acceptance limits.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_trend_confidence
new_categories.memory: Trend confidence can be represented separately from a single indication without retaining rate-of-change values, thresholds or alarm rules.

new_categories.label: self_heating_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence state for possible self-heating condition can be retained without claiming a cargo-specific threshold, diagnosis or response action.

new_categories.label: cross_check_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate cross-check confidence is distinct from the primary indication and can degrade separately without retaining measurement procedures.

new_categories.label: cargo_condition_effect_not_monitoring_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Cargo-condition concern, heating concern or receiver uncertainty is a downstream interpretation and is not equivalent to monitoring-service readiness or measurement validity.

new_categories.label: monitoring_service_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Cargo-temperature/self-heating monitoring can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to the measurement path, cargo/hold scope, indication validity, trend confidence or cross-check state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-condition uncertainty, hold restriction, terminal/receiver concern, rework or schedule effects do not prove a sensor, measurement, coverage or cargo-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_monitoring_restoration
new_categories.memory: Measurement-path correction, indication recovery, cross-check verification, restriction release and return to normal cargo monitoring can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: hold_environment_vs_cargo_mass_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P110 hold temperature/humidity monitoring does not duplicate monitoring of cargo-mass temperature or self-heating condition.

useful_refinements.label: single_indication_vs_trend_confidence
useful_refinements.memory: A valid single cargo-temperature indication does not by itself establish confidence in a self-heating trend.

useful_refinements.label: cargo_condition_judgment_vs_measurement_service
useful_refinements.memory: Cargo-condition judgment or receiver concern is downstream of, and distinct from, measurement-service availability and validity.

useful_refinements.label: generic_sensor_lifecycle_vs_delivered_cargo_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered cargo-mass temperature/self-heating monitoring readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_sensor_scope_indication_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic sensor/measurement availability, bounded scope, indication validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior monitoring families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.
